info.title: StockIQ — WMS API
info.description:
API REST do StockIQ (WMS / ERP Lite).

**Autenticação:** faça `POST /api/auth/login`, copie o `token` retornado e clique em **Authorize** (esquema `bearerAuth`).

**Perfis:** `admin` > `supervisor` > `operator` > `viewer`. Cada operação lista os perfis permitidos.

**Erros:** respostas de erro seguem `{ "message": string }`; validações retornam 422 com `errors[]`.

quantity.description: Units moved. For `inventory` this is the counted stock (absolute); the difference is applied as an adjustment.

manufacturingDate.description: Needed together with expirationDate when an entry creates a new lot.

unitCost.description: Defaults to the product purchase price.

lotNumber.description: On entries, creates the lot (needs supplierId + expirationDate) or increments an existing one.

fromAddressId.description: Required for transfers and, for products already stocked in the warehouse, for exits, losses, decreasing adjustments and counts.

toAddressId.description: Required for transfers and, for products already stocked in the warehouse, for entries and increasing adjustments.

MovementRequest.description: Stock effect: entry +qty · exit/loss −qty · adjustment ±qty (adjustmentDirection) · inventory sets stock to qty · transfer 0 (moves between addresses). Products tracked by lot also need lotNumber.

status.description: Derived from expirationDate (≤30 days = expiring) unless the lot is in quarantine.

productIds.description: Required for partial and cyclic counts; full counts include every active product.

status.description: Allowed transitions: planned → in_progress → review → completed (review may return to in_progress). Review requires every item counted.

id.description: Stable alert key used to mark as read.

desc.example: O produto QM-0091 atingiu zero unidades em estoque.

trend.description: % change in movement count, last 30 days vs previous 30.

expiryAlertDays.description: Lots expiring within this window are flagged and alert.

Forbidden.description: Perfil sem permissão para esta operação

Conflict.description: Conflito (valor único já existente ou registro vinculado)
